item.statement: The observable output contract is an exact element permutation; this item checks the full mapping through permutation invariants and inverse-shift restoration rather than a fixed golden.

plans.objective: Verify full-output permutation behavior without relying on a single golden vector.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the two launches on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata1 and odata2.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff odata1 is a permutation of the source (each source value appears exactly once) and odata2 is bitwise identical to the original source.
plans.setup: Use unique source bit patterns; run forward shift (a,b), then run the inverse shift (-a,-b) over the first output storage; capture both outputs.
